gates.rationale: 6/6 findings resolved; authenticate early return and deactivate_user deviation accepted by user

rationale: All 6 prior blocking findings are resolved on source/evidence inspection. Two deviations from spec text were assessed and accepted: authenticate() now reuses the caller stored on request.state by the guard (server-side only, not client-settable, touches a spec non-goal minimally), and deactivation runs deactivate_user under a row lock in the router transaction instead of deactivate_user_flow (avoids self-deadlock). CR-006 is a legitimate no-op since route_precedence.json lists only overlapping route pairs and idp-sync routes have none; tests were not re-run here (Stage 7).

findings.title: Row-locked admin count has no real test
findings.problem: Every service test stubs lock_and_count_active_admins; the real query (active, non-deleted admins, FOR UPDATE) is never executed or asserted.
findings.impact: Dropping with_for_update() or the is_active/deleted_at filter would ship a last-admin race without any test failing. Consumer: IdpSyncService._ensure_not_last_admin via PUT /v1/idp-sync/users/{user_id}.
findings.recommendation: Add a repository test seeding admin, inactive-admin, soft-deleted-admin and non-admin users, asserting the count, plus a PostgreSQL compiled-statement check that the SQL contains FOR UPDATE.
findings.check_notes: Repository tests added: counts only active non-deleted admins and asserts FOR UPDATE in compiled PostgreSQL statement.

fix.change: Added real-SQL tests for lock_and_count_active_admins (filters, FOR UPDATE on PostgreSQL dialect)

findings.title: Bad project name path gives 500, not 422
findings.problem: assign_project builds IdpAssignRequest(project_name=...) inside the handler; a blank-after-strip or over-255 char path segment raises a pydantic ValidationError there, which FastAPI does not map to a 422. Path user_id is also not UUID-validated on non-PUT routes.
findings.impact: Malformed input surfaces as a 500 instead of a validation error (AC14). Likely live since the construction is unconditional on the route.
findings.recommendation: Validate at the route: project_name: str = Path(min_length=1, max_length=255), and normalise/validate path user_id the same way as the body id.
findings.check_notes: Path(min_length, max_length, pattern) on user_id and project_name; tests assert 422; openapi baseline updated.

fix.change: Path params validated at the route (length, non-blank project name) so bad input is 422

findings.title: Sync-account restriction fails open on some routes
findings.problem: _requires_authentication returns False for non-APIRoute routes (mounted sub-apps, websockets) and for routes that authenticate via a dependency other than authenticate, so the guard returns early without checking the caller. Reachability of such routes in the real app was not confirmed.
findings.impact: The sync account could reach routes outside /v1/idp-sync/, contradicting the documented 'every other authenticated route answers 403'. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Fail closed: for non-public routes outside the prefix, resolve the caller and deny the sync account unless the route is on an explicit public allowlist; handle non-APIRoute routes explicitly.
findings.check_notes: _requires_authentication now returns True for non-APIRoute; fail-closed tests added.

fix.change: Guard treats non-APIRoute routes as authenticated (fail closed)

findings.title: Every authenticated request authenticates twice
findings.problem: enforce_idp_sync_identity calls authenticate directly, then the route's own Depends(authenticate) runs again; the spec requires the caller to be resolved once per request.
findings.impact: With the setting non-empty, each authenticated request pays double token/DB/IdP lookups and any replay or nonce check may fail on the second pass.
findings.recommendation: Make the app-level guard depend on authenticate via Depends so FastAPI caches the result, or reuse request.state.user set by the first authentication.
findings.check_notes: Guard stores User on request.state; authenticate returns it if isinstance User. request.state is server-side per-request scope, not client-settable, so no bypass; spec non-goal touched minimally.

fix.change: Guard stores resolved caller on request.state; authenticate reuses it

findings.title: Deactivation last-admin check is not row-locked
findings.problem: deactivate delegates to deactivate_user_flow, which uses the unlocked count_active_admins (user_management_service.py:289) and commits in its own session, outside the router transaction. Also assign calls session.rollback() itself while the router owns the transaction.
findings.impact: Two parallel deactivations, or a deactivation racing a demotion, can both pass and leave zero active admins, violating AC15.
findings.recommendation: Take lock_and_count_active_admins before delegating, in the same transaction, and drop the in-service session.rollback() in assign.
findings.check_notes: Row lock taken for admin targets, deactivate_user runs in router transaction, post-commit cleanup/cache invalidation; in-service rollback removed. Deviates from deactivate_user_flow text to avoid self-deadlock; accepted.

fix.change: Deactivation runs in the router transaction under the admin row lock; post-commit cleanup split out; assign no longer rolls back itself

findings.title: route_precedence baseline not regenerated
findings.problem: The spec and AC12 require both openapi.json and route_precedence.json to be regenerated; the file has no idp-sync entries and is not in the diff.
findings.impact: AC12 unmet; the router-guard baseline does not cover the new routes.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate route_precedence.json with the project's baseline tooling and commit it, or record why it is not required.
findings.check_notes: Regeneration exit 0 with head matching reviewed_head; route_precedence.json lists only overlapping route pairs and idp-sync routes have none, so no change is correct.

fix.change: Baselines regenerated; route_precedence unchanged (new routes overlap nothing), openapi idp-sync entries updated
